description: Utility helpers for enriching documents with normalized projectId and updatedAt, including functions for normalizing project IDs, parsing dates, computing update timestamps, and enriching deployment-like documents.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of projectId fields to a lowercase string id, accepting strings, numbers, and objects with specific fields.

methods.name: toValidDate
methods.description: Parses a value into a valid Date object if possible, else returns null.

methods.name: computeUpdatedAt
methods.description: Computes the most relevant updatedAt date from a document's fields or _id timestamp.

methods.name: enrichDeployment
methods.description: Enriches a deployment-like document with normalized projectId and updatedAt fields.
